findings.summary: Goal version activation remains unwired into the production composition path: build_line constructs GoalRequestKernel with an empty active_version and no production code calls activate_version, so the version-bound approve/reject guard compares against an empty version until a live version event arrives. The explicit-version and stale-version-refusal semantics are fully implemented and offline-tested (TestExplicitGoalVersions, TestStaleVersionApproval, TestLiveVersionAtReviewBoundary); wiring a goal.md content_revision -> activate_version source is deferred integration consistent with the spec's deferred later slices (full MCP enroll/repo lifecycle, live binding), not a development-stage violation.
